properties.notes: Main constraints: Town centres and retailing Local Plan Core Policy CP12, Dursley Conservation Area, listed buildings, existing car parking, access and multiple ownership. Summary: The site is considered suitable for redevelopment for housing/town centre uses subject to the scale, massing and detailed design of any development reflecting the historic urban grain of Dursley Conservation Area. There is no evidence that any of this area is available currently but there is a reasonable prospect that any suitable land will be available at a point in the future for development and that development as envisaged will be delivered on the site within 15 years.. This site could be developed for high density development, comprising apartments at an average density of about 60 dph, subject to providing for parking for existing uses, and the suggested yield for a residential scheme across the net developable area is 11 units.
